name: Claude (out of process)
description: Runs Claude through Anthropic's Agent SDK in its own process, over Studio's agent protocol.
detail: Early: runs a turn, streams text and tool activity, and asks permission. Does not yet do sub-agents, tool policy, MCP or remote control — which is why a connection has to name it rather than it replacing the built-in Claude provider. Downloads around 200MB: the SDK ships its Claude Code CLI as a native binary, and one platform's is fetched.
